title: Kaeya — Complete Character Guide & Talent Reference
summary: Complete reference for Kaeya: 4-star Cryo Sword user. Includes Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, Elemental Burst talent descriptions with scaling values, passive talents, all 6 constellation effects, and ascension material requirements.
content:
# Kaeya — Complete Character Reference

## Overview
- **Name**: Kaeya
- **Title**: Frostwind Swordsman
- **Rarity**: ★★★★
- **Element / Vision**: Cryo
- **Weapon Type**: Sword
- **Nation**: Mondstadt
- **Affiliation**: Knights of Favonius
- **Constellation**: Pavo Ocellus
- **Birthday**: 0000-11-30
- **Special Dish**: None

> An accomplished swordsman and a strategic thinker in the Knights of Favonius, rumored to hail from beyond Mondstadt.

## Combat Talents

### Normal Attack: Ceremonial Bladework
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive strikes.
Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.
Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging enemeies along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

**Scaling Values (Lv. 1):**
- 1-Hit DMG: 53.8%
- 2-Hit DMG: 51.7%
- 3-Hit DMG: 65.3%
- 4-Hit DMG: 70.9%
- 5-Hit DMG: 88.2%
- Charged Attack DMG: 55% + 73.1%
- Charged Attack Stamina Cost: 20
- Plunge DMG: 63.9%
- Low / High Plunge DMG: 128% / 160%

### Elemental Skill: Frostgnaw
Unleashes a frigit blast, dealing Cryo DMG to enemies in front of Kaeya.

**Scaling Values (Lv. 1):**
- Skill DMG: 191%
- CD: 6s

### Elemental Burst: Glacial Waltz
Coalescing the frost in the air, Kaeya summons 3 icicles that revolve around him.

These icicles will follow the character around and deal Cryo DMG to enemies in their path for so long as they persist.

**Scaling Values (Lv. 1):**
- Skill DMG: 77.6%
- CD: 15s
- Duration: 8s
- Energy Cost: 60

## Passive Talents

### Cold-Blooded Strike (Unlocked at Ascension 1)
Every hit with Frostgnaw regenerates HP for Kaeya equal to 15% of ATK.

### Glacial Heart (Unlocked at Ascension 4)
Enemies Frozen by Frostgnaw will drop additional Elemental Particles.
Frostgnaw may only produce a maximum of 2 additional Elemental Particles per use.

### Hidden Strength (Unlocked Automatically)
Decreases all party member's sprinting Stamina consumption by 20%.

## Constellations

### C1: Excellent Blood
The CRIT Rate of Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG against enemies affected by the Cold or Frozen status effects is increased by 15%.

### C2: Never-Ending Performance
Every time Glacial Waltz defeats an enemy, its duration is increased by 2.5s, up to a maximum of 15s.

### C3: Dance of Frost
Increases the Level of Frostgnaw by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

### C4: Frozen Kiss
Triggers automatically when Kaeya's HP falls below 20%:
Creates a shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of Kaeya's Max HP. Lasts for 20s.
This shield absorbs Cryo DMG with 250% efficiency.
Can only occur once every 60s.

### C5: Frostbiting Embrace
Increase the Level of Glacial Waltz by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

### C6: Glacial Whirlwind
Glacial Waltz will generate 1 additional icicle, and will regenerate 15 Energy when cast.

## Ascension Materials
- **Level 20**: Shivada Jade Sliver ×1, Calla Lily ×3, Treasure Hoarder Insignia ×3, Mora ×20000
- **Level 40**: Shivada Jade Fragment ×3, Hoarfrost Core ×2, Calla Lily ×10, Treasure Hoarder Insignia ×15, Mora ×40000
- **Level 50**: Shivada Jade Fragment ×6, Hoarfrost Core ×4, Calla Lily ×20, Silver Raven Insignia ×12, Mora ×60000
- **Level 60**: Shivada Jade Chunk ×3, Hoarfrost Core ×8, Calla Lily ×30, Silver Raven Insignia ×18, Mora ×80000
- **Level 70**: Shivada Jade Chunk ×6, Hoarfrost Core ×12, Calla Lily ×45, Golden Raven Insignia ×12, Mora ×100000
- **Level 80**: Shivada Jade Gemstone ×6, Hoarfrost Core ×20, Calla Lily ×60, Golden Raven Insignia ×24, Mora ×120000
